description: Header file defining the CpuConsumer class, a BufferQueue consumer endpoint for direct CPU access to graphics buffers in Android. It includes class definitions, data structures, and method declarations related to buffer locking and unlocking.

classes.name: CpuConsumer
classes.description: A BufferQueue consumer endpoint that provides direct CPU access to graphics buffers, allowing multiple buffers to be acquired and used concurrently.

classes.name: CpuConsumer::LockedBuffer
classes.description: Structure representing a locked graphics buffer with metadata such as dimensions, format, and data pointers.

methods.name: CpuConsumer
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new CPU consumer with specified buffer locking capacity.

methods.name: lockNextBuffer
methods.description: Locks the next available buffer for CPU access, filling the provided LockedBuffer structure.

methods.name: unlockBuffer
methods.description: Releases a previously locked buffer back to the queue for reuse.
